cohort: Pregnant women from the Growing Up in Singapore Towards healthy Outcomes (GUSTO) cohort (n = 1100, recruited 2009-2010) and the National University Hospital (NUH) cohort (n = 4068, recruited 2017-2018) in Singapore
finding: Taller women had an increased odds of GDM-related pregnancy complications, while shorter women did not, suggesting a possible artefactual GDM diagnosis due to glucose-overload among shorter women.
